stories.title: A month closed within tolerance, and its halala a month later

book.note: General ledger bank account, closing balance
General ledger bank account, closing balance

stories.recipe: July: a 2,400.00 remittance the book receives as 2,399.99, tolerated; two payments the book dated six days early, a group of two date gaps accepted together; an unpresented cheque of 1,250.00 and an unbooked fee of 35.00. August: the cheque is presented and the fee booked, both cleared by accepting their carried cases; a 0.02 difference tolerated under a new declaration; a 4.00 difference rejected. The July halala, tolerated but never booked, is still between the bank and the book in August: the August sheet shows it unexplained.

stories.title: Arabic: a tolerated pair rejected and carried, a carried difference no tolerance touches

book.note: رصيد حساب البنك في الأستاذ العام
رصيد حساب البنك في الأستاذ العام

stories.recipe: Arabic, Arabic-Indic digits, two pages a month. August: a 1,000.01 remittance the book receives as 1,000.00, tolerated and then rejected by the accountant, both members outstanding; two references each paid in two transfers and booked once, a group of two duplicate-reference cases rejected together; a deposit in transit of 500.00. September: the deposit arrives as 500.01, a carried case with an amount difference within the new declaration, which a tolerance never touches: rejected; a 700.01 payment the book pays as 700.00, tolerated. The rejected July members and the duplicates stay carried, two months old.

stories.title: Past the period limit, rejected in a group, carried

book.note: General ledger bank account, closing balance
General ledger bank account, closing balance

stories.recipe: September: two payments the bank takes 0.90 and 0.50 above the book and a receipt it credits 0.75 below it: 2.15 in all, past a period limit of 1.50, though they net to 0.65: none tolerated; the two payments rejected together from the queue, the receipt alone; six members outstanding. October: they stay carried; a new 0.01 difference tolerated; the declared book balance is 10.00 below the book, a rest without explanation.

stories.title: An undecided month refused as previous, then taken once decided

book.note: General ledger bank account, closing balance
General ledger bank account, closing balance
General ledger bank account, closing balance

stories.recipe: October, saved once with a date gap undecided and once after accepting it; a deposit in transit of 450.00. November taken first on the undecided session: refused as undecided, nothing carried, the sheet refused with it; then on the decided one: the deposit arrives and its carried case is accepted.

stories.title: Arabic: a ledger column inserted, the saved map no longer fits

book.note: رصيد حساب البنك في الأستاذ العام
رصيد حساب البنك في الأستاذ العام

stories.recipe: Arabic, Latin digits. November: two differences of 0.01 and 0.02 tolerated; a third of 0.01 whose book date is four days before the bank's, beyond the window, which no tolerance reaches: rejected and carried; an unpresented cheque of 2,300.00. December: the ledger gains a value-date column, so the saved map does not fit and the columns are chosen again; no tolerance is declared, so a 0.01 difference waits and is rejected; the cheque is presented and its carried case accepted. November's tolerated differences, never booked, remain between bank and book.

stories.title: Across the year end: queues, tolerance and a cheque still out

book.note: General ledger bank account, closing balance
General ledger bank account, closing balance

stories.recipe: Across the year end, three pages a month. December: differences of 0.01, 0.02 and 0.03 meet a period limit of 0.06 exactly; three payments booked five days early accepted together from the queue, and two direct debits booked under other references, suggested by amount and date and accepted together; a deposit in transit of 770.00 and an unpresented cheque of 640.00. January: the deposit arrives without a reference, a carried suggestion by amount, accepted; the December cheque is still unpresented and a January cheque joins it in the same section, December first; two date gaps rejected together; two differences of 0.01 tolerated.
